title: BHUNTER: Generating Blind-Spot Driving Scenarios for Robustness Testing of Autonomous Driving Perception
description:
BHUNTER searches simulated traffic for blind-spot driving scenarios at a chosen occlusion level and exports synchronized camera and LiDAR data for detection and tracking. This archive is the software and benchmark accompanying the ACM TOSEM 2026 paper.

A blind spot is a short interval in which a candidate road user is hidden by one or more occluders. BHUNTER scores that interval with a scenario-level temporal occlusion rate (STOR), computed from visible, externally occluded, and self-occluded voxels, then uses occlusion-guided fuzzing in CARLA to reach a requested level. The released benchmark contains 2,000 scenarios, 400 at each of five occlusion levels.

Project page: https://alexps9.github.io/BHUNTER/
